Quick Microwave Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:38am

Ingredients




1 can apple pie filling
1 pkg. Jiffy yellow cake mix
1/2 stick butter
2 tablespoons white sugar with cinnamon mixed in
1/4 cup pecans

Preparation

1 Pour pie filling in deep dish pie pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Sprinkle evenly with cinnamon sugar. Add 1/4 chopped pecans if desired. Bake on high 11 to 13 minutes. Cherry pie filling may be substituted.
